hooks.name: platform-reader
hooks.reason: Builds the membership reader of a deployed cluster from its Connection: plain REST against the Kubernetes API, and the k0s controller leases when the Integration enables them.

hooks.name: platform-credential
hooks.reason: Turns the k0s credential role's result into the cluster's read Integration: endpoint, token, and the CA to verify the API with, or insecureSkipVerify for an earlier role that returned none.

hooks.name: platform
hooks.reason: Converts between the Platform spec and the Kubernetes deploy request (members as roleAssignments) and classifies a spec change per desired-state-model §5.2, marking what swallow cannot carry out yet.

validations.title: Kubernetes smoke test
validations.description: Checks that every node is Ready, that a pod runs on every node that takes workloads, that cluster DNS resolves, and that a ClusterIP Service routes between pods. It runs short-lived pods in namespace swallow-validation and deletes them.

checks.title: Nodes Ready
checks.description: Every node is Ready, and every member that runs workloads is a node.

checks.title: Pod scheduling
checks.description: A pod the scheduler places on each node that takes workloads runs to completion.

checks.title: Cluster DNS
checks.description: A pod resolves kubernetes.default through cluster DNS.

checks.title: Service routing
checks.description: A pod reaches another, on a different node when there is one, through a ClusterIP Service.
